connector.name: RigorLoop Research Bounties
connector.registryDescription: Search and commission verified human research review through funded Research Bounties.
connector.summary: Hosted at rigorloop.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.rigorloop. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <RigorLoop agent key>; optional for public search
